configurations.name: resto-rant-demo
runtimeArgs: $env:JAVA_HOME = Join-Path (Get-Location) '.tools\jdk-21.0.12.1'; $env:PATH = $env:JAVA_HOME + '\bin;' + $env:PATH; $repo = Join-Path (Get-Location) '.tools\maven-repository'; Set-Location backend; if (Test-Path '.local\admin-password.txt') { $env:SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL = 'admin@restorant.local'; $env:SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD = (Get-Content -Raw '.local\admin-password.txt').Trim() }; & .\mvnw.cmd -B -ntp ('-Dmaven.repo.local=' + $repo) '-Dspring-boot.run.profiles=demo' spring-boot:run
